rules.title: Segment Length identifies the segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators
Segment 112 has a maximum length of 999 alphanumeric characters
Segment 112 appears only at the end of a Financial Transaction response
BUYPASS originates transmission of Segment 112 content (host-originated, not device)
The Additional Information section (elements 116/117/118) repeats once per Additional Information Indicator, up to a maximum of 990 bytes total
Additional Information Indicator (Element 116) identifies the type of additional information being transmitted
Additional Information Length (Element 117) identifies the length of the following Additional Information (Element 118)
Additional Information (Element 118) is variable length and carries the value identified by its paired Indicator/Length
Segment 112 is required in a Financial Transaction Response only when Element 115 (Additional Information Data Segment Flag) equals 1
